provenance: Independently generated NumPy oracle; raw-observation residual profile and 3x3 nuisance-alpha Fisher. Node implementation never used to generate these expected answers.

source.title: Cramér-Rao Bound Optimization for Joint Radar-Communication Beamforming
source.edition: IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing 70, 240–253 (2022), published journal version

kernel.reviewScope: Bounded offline JavaScript/worker feasibility; browser acceptance is a separate gate

conventions.inputDigest: SHA-256 of sorted-key canonical numeric JSON, UTF-8, v1
conventions.H: Rows are h_k^H; complex coefficients, no normalization
conventions.Wc: Nt by K; amplitude in sqrt(mW)
conventions.covariance: Wks and relaxedR in mW; ensemble stream covariance
conventions.angle: degrees for input; derivatives and CRB in radians
conventions.gamma: one common SINR threshold in dB
conventions.outputTrust: Imported outputs are historical claims until a new current-kernel run

resources.tracePolicy: Full kernel trace retained; rendered progress bounded separately

rankCondition.method: two-column QR residual with reorthogonalization; small eigenvalue from determinant/large eigenvalue
rankCondition.required: rank(H[a,a_dot])=2; Eq.(33) is not a general K=1 replacement

result.scope: actual offline-tested browser-capable point Eq33 prototype; no browser latency measured

certificate.interpretation: floating-point trace-bounded dual check, not interval arithmetic
